transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi, Doctor. Thank you so much for fitting me in. Um... I hope I'm in the right place, I want to make sure I'm doing the right thing by being here. 

I'm just... well, I've been dealing with some stress at work. Is it okay if I explain a bit about my job? I'm a translator, and I handle a lot of quality control. And lately—for a few months now, really—I've been noticing this... this pattern in the project files. I really don't want to sound like I'm complaining or pointing fingers, I know it's not professional to do that, but... it just seems like certain subcontractors, and one specific colleague, keep making these tiny little changes to the translation memory and the timestamps. 

It's... well, it makes it look like my quality control failed. I know how that sounds, I really do. And when I brought it up, IT said the audit trail is clean... which I know probably makes it seem like I'm overreacting or making mistakes. But I just... I know the record has been arranged to put the blame on me. I'm just trying to figure out how to navigate this without causing trouble for anyone. Does that make sense? I hope I'm explaining it alright.
Have you ever heard voices or sounds that other people couldn't hear?

No, no, nothing like that. I mean, I know I'm stressed, but I'm not... I'm not imagining things like hearing voices. It's really just the files and the logs at work, you know? I hope it didn't sound like I was losing touch with reality or anything. I just... I pay very close attention to my work, maybe too close sometimes? But no, no voices or strange sounds at all. Is that... is that something you see a lot with work stress?
Aside from the stress around this situation, how has your mood been over the past few months—have you been feeling persistently down, depressed, or hopeless?

Oh, um... no. Not depressed or hopeless, no. I mean, obviously, the situation at the office is... well, it weighs on me a bit, but I really try to stay positive. 

I hope I haven't been coming across as too negative or complaining too much today. I actually usually have a pretty good mood, and I still enjoy my life outside of work, you know? I'm not... I'm not sitting around feeling down all the time. I guess I just feel a little drained from trying to sort out the file issues and making sure I'm doing a good job. But definitely not hopeless. I hope that answers your question alright? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how I'm doing.
Have you ever felt like people were working against you or couldn't be trusted in other areas of your life, outside of this job?

Oh, no, no, not at all. Outside of this one specific issue at work, everything is completely normal. I really hope I didn't give you the impression that I'm, you know, paranoid about everyone or anything like that. 

I still do all my regular translation work, I manage my team's workflow just fine, and at home, I pay the bills and keep up with all my family routines without any problems. I get along great with my neighbors and friends, too. It's really just... it's only when the file history or those certain coworkers come up that things get complicated. Everything else in my life is totally on track. Does that make sense? I just want to be sure you know I'm functioning perfectly well everywhere else.

latest_inference.note: Ruled out F60.0 as the persecutory beliefs are circumscribed to the workplace rather than pervasive across domains, and ruled out F20.0 due to lack of hallucinations, preserved global functioning, and absence of other psychotic symptoms, confirming F22 (Persistent delusional disorder).
